Disposable support image for the complete agent-control R10 bed. It contains the pinned native Pi SDK runtime and Pi-TUI, Claude Code, tmux control mode, and an OpenSSH endpoint. The worktree Charly package supplies the CUE-generated provider channel, agent control plugin, Pi provider, tmux provider, MCP reflection, and generic deployment process transport; no permanent agent service is baked.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `@github.com/opencharly/charly/candy/plugin-agent:v2026.231.0530`
- `@github.com/opencharly/charly/candy/plugin-agent-pi:v2026.231.0530`
